messages:
aya: Quick idea  "Summer Sips & Scrabble" next Wed 7/24 @ 6:30pm in the lounge. Low-key: mocktails, snacks, and a few Scrabble boards. In-person + Zoom for remote friends. React with emoji: :scrabble: = Ill play IRL, :video_game: = remote but joining Zoom, :cocktail: = want mocktails.
marc: :scrabble: Im in. Can bring my deluxe board and the tile bag.
priya: :cocktail: Love mocktails  can I bring a non-alcoholic ginger mojito mix?
derek: :video_game: Remote that night but will pop in for a round or two via Zoom.
zoe: :scrabble: :cocktail: I can help with snacks, and I have a small magnetic board for spill-prone tables.
aya: Perfect  looks like a mix. Quick logistics: please RSVP by Monday so I can order two mocktail pitchers and pizza for folks on-site. If >8 IRL we'll grab a second board. Also tagging @marcom in case anyone wants photos for socials (optional).
marc: Heads-up  I can host a "speed round" tournament (10-min games) if people are up for it. Prize: winner picks next office playlist.
priya: Love the playlist prize. Also any allergies? Im gluten-free, so GF slice pls if ordering pizza.
derek: Noted  GF option appreciated.
zoe: Ill bring labeled snack bowls (GF and nut-free).
aya: social-bot, can you create the calendar invite and set a reminder 24hrs before? Include the Zoom link please.
social-bot: Event created: "Summer Sips & Scrabble"  Wed Jul 24  6:30 PM  Lounge + Zoom  RSVP: https://calendar.example.com/event/sips123 (reminder 24 hours prior)
marc: One last poll: speed tournament or casual free-play? React :trophy: = tournament, :relaxed: = casual.
priya: :relaxed: (Im there for snacks and chat)
derek: :trophy: (remote tournament cameo)
zoe: :relaxed:
aya: Mixed preference. I'll do a casual night but run an optional speed table for those who want to join at 8pm. RSVP by Mon and I'll finalize food counts. See you there  or on Zoom! :scrabble: :sparkles:
